title: RESULTS: November 2026 Veterinarians Computer-Based Licensure Examination
summary: PRESS RELEASE: The Professional Regulation Commission announces that 1,083 out of 1,503 passed the Veterinarians Computer-Based Licensure Examination

blocks.text: PRESS RELEASE: The Professional Regulation Commission announces that 1,083 out of 1,503 passed the Veterinarians Computer-Based Licensure Examination
The following is a press release from the Professional Regulation Commission.

The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) announces that 1,083 out of 1,503 passed the Veterinarians Computer-Based Licensure Examination given by the Board of Veterinary Medicine in N. C. R., Baguio, Cagayan de Oro, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Koronadal, Legazpi, Lucena, Pampanga, Rosales, Tuguegarao and Puerto Princesa, Palawan this November 2026.
The members of the Board of Veterinary Medicine who gave the licensure examination are Dr. Agnes Teodora A. Baylon, Chairperson; Dr. Claro N. Mingala and Dr. Tomas M. Acorda, Members.
The results were released in one (1) working day after the last day of examination.

Starting December 7, 2026, registration for the issuance of Professional Identification Card (ID) and Certificate of Registration will be done on-line. Please visit the official PRC website and follow the instructions for registration. Those who will register are required to bring the following: 1) Screenshot of system-generated Registration Form; 2) valid government-issued ID. Successful examinees should personally register and sign in the Roster of Registered Professionals.
The date and venue for the oathtaking ceremony of the new successful examinees in the said examination WILL BE ANNOUNCED LATER.
